key_features: ARGB Illumination: Stunning Addressable RGB lighting for a visually striking setup.
Adjustable Fan Speeds: Operates between 500 to 2000 RPM for customizable cooling.
High Airflow: Offers 75.89 CFM for effective heat dissipation.
Low Noise Level: Runs at a quiet ≤31.6 dB(A) for peaceful operation.
Optimized Air Pressure: Boasts 2.53 MmAq for efficient airflow management.
Hydro Bearing: Ensures durability and reduced friction for prolonged use.
Efficient LED Setup: Uses 3-Pin (+5V-D-G) LED connectors for vibrant lighting.
Universal Socket Support: Compatible with Intel LGA1700/1200/1151/1150/1155 and AMD AM5/AM4 sockets.
Reliable Performance: Features a robust heatsink with four Ø6 mm heat pipes for optimal thermal dissipation.
Compact Design: Product dimensions of 125×92×150 mm and fan dimensions of 120×120×25 mm.
Lightweight: Weighs 614 grams for easy installation and handling.
Rated Voltage: Operates at 12 VDC with a power consumption of 3.36 W.
